Novopavlivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Novopavlivka, Ukraine

Demolished. This cemetery is marked on 1917 Russian topographic maps but absent from 1941 maps, suggesting demolition during WWII or under postwar Soviet administration; a neighbor recalls his grandmother describing the site's two sections, one for women and one for men - today it's divided into two parts by a ditch. Little is documented about the Jewish community itself; population reached 953 (60%) by 1897 and 934 by 1926. Wehrmacht occupation from August 1941 saw part of the community executed that September, while the remaining Jews were expelled to the Bolshaya Vradievka labor camp.
